Usage: SISR <command> [flags]

SISR - Steam Input System Redirector

    Version: v0.6.2 (5cfde20)
             2026-10-11T00:08:44Z
    Source:  https://github.com/Alia5/SISR
    License: GPLv3

Flags:
  -h, --help                Show context-sensitive help.
      --config=STRING       Path to configuration file (json|yaml|toml)
                            ($SISR_CONFIG)
      --log.level="info"    Log level: trace, debug, info, warn, error
                            ($SISR_LOG_LEVEL)
      --log.file=STRING     Log file path ($SISR_LOG_FILE)
      --console             Show console window ($SISR_CONSOLE)

Commands:
  run [flags]
    Run SISR (Default)

  checkrates [flags]
    Measure Steam Input polling rate

  inputmon [flags]
    Log gamepad input changes to console

Run "SISR <command> --help" for more information on a command.
